____________________________________________________

|  |                                                                                                    |  |
|  |                  f ( u / n * c + t * i | o & n % s )                                     |  |

|  |                                                                                                    |  |
|  |                  #25 ( Here here little Jellyfish )                                   |  |
|  |__________________________________________________|  |
| /__________________________________________________\ |

More broken delay effect "goodness" :p
When i start to think about it, has anyone really made a jellyfish preset before? Sure lots of presets are named "jellyfish-something", but an actually jellyfish model? Anyone? I can't remember anyone doing that.

So here is one! Im quite proud of it although im sure if someone *cough*unconed,pak-9,jheriko*cough* makes another jellyfish preset it's going to be much much better. Im actually looking forward to such occasion! :)

I don't want to ruin this one for over-analyzing it, so i'll just thank you for watching my humble AVS pack and wish you enjoyed it.

code.init:
// master scope
n=0 ; reg02=0 ; reg03=4.5

code.perFrame:
sec=reg00 ; vol=reg01 ; resfix=reg09*0.75 ;

yt=0 ; eql=n ; spd=n*2 ; xt=n*3 ; freq=n*4 ; wobwid=n*5 ;
wob=n*6 ; wobble=n*7 ; xflip=n*8 ; yflip=n*9 ; color=n*10 ;
size=n*11 ; shade=n*12 ;

loop(n,
exec3(
	exec3(
		exec3(
		assign(megabuf(yt),if(above(megabuf(yt),1.5),-1.5,megabuf(yt)+sec*megabuf(spd))),
		assign(megabuf(eql),equal(megabuf(yt),-1.5)),
		assign(megabuf(spd),if(megabuf(eql),rand(21)*0.01*vol+0.5+rand(6)*0.1,megabuf(spd))))
		,
		exec3(
		assign(megabuf(xt),if(megabuf(eql),(rand(w*2+1)-w)/w,megabuf(xt))),
		assign(megabuf(freq),if(megabuf(eql),(1+rand(5))*$pi,megabuf(freq))),
		assign(megabuf(wobwid),if(megabuf(eql),(1+rand(15))*0.01,megabuf(wobwid))))
		,
		exec3(
		assign(megabuf(wob),megabuf(wob)+sec*megabuf(freq)*megabuf(spd)*0.5),
		assign(megabuf(wobble),sin(megabuf(wob))*megabuf(wobwid)),
		assign(megabuf(xflip),if(megabuf(eql),1-(rand(100)%2)*2,megabuf(xflip))))
		)
	,
	exec3(
		exec3(
		assign(megabuf(yflip),if(megabuf(eql),1-(rand(100)%2)*2,megabuf(yflip))),
		assign(megabuf(color),if(megabuf(eql),rand(100)%3,megabuf(color))),
		exec3(
		assign(megabuf(size),if(megabuf(eql),0.1+rand(91)*0.01,megabuf(size))),
		assign(megabuf(shade),if(megabuf(eql),(64+rand(192))/255,megabuf(shade))),
		assign(yt,yt+1)))
		,
		exec3(
		assign(eql,eql+1),
		assign(spd,spd+1),
		assign(xt,xt+1))
		,
		exec3(
		assign(freq,freq+1),
		assign(wobwid,wobwid+1),
		assign(wob,wob+1))
		)
	,
	exec2(
		exec3(
		assign(wobble,wobble+1),
		assign(xflip,xflip+1),
		assign(yflip,yflip+1))
		,
		exec3(
		assign(color,color+1),
		assign(size,size+1),
		assign(shade,shade+1))
		)
	) 
)
